answer: Participants stake a bonded deposit to join a trellis of vetted peers, and each new identity must be vouched for by two existing members who risk part of their own stake. A sybil cluster therefore triggers a ripple of slashed collateral across its vouchers, while honest agents build reputation in a slow spiral of rising limits. Forging N identities costs N deposits plus the vouchers' exposure, making mass infiltration economically irrational. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
